HOG method: Dalal & Triggs, 2005: https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2005.177
Actual project training from random initialization, not supplied Navrasa or paper weights. Train 23503, validation 3970, test 6561, seed 42. Exact grayscale-pixel duplicates removed. Combined Kaggle test folder includes examples previously used in the old pilot evaluation, not a fresh dataset or original FER PrivateTest-only/identity-disjoint protocol. Best checkpoint epoch 39, SHA-256 dbc4a9f9293fb4e1b28ae249958964cfe12e1b3b17a18f7e75bea77925b7a4ba. Architecture v2 adds normalized inputs/fusion and spatial 2x2 pooling; all dimensions are project assumptions. AdamW/cosine, class-weighted smoothed CE + 0.05 reconstruction MSE. Accuracy 0.5255296448712087, macro precision 0.4718198623111246, recall 0.4485359808038777, F1 0.44916607283447024. Baseline reevaluated on exactly the same retained test faces: accuracy 0.2652034750800183, macro F1 0.10478527891409024. The selected candidate may include classifier-only refinement on frozen features, with training-fitted normalization folded into the existing MLP. Epoch indices combine full-network and head phases; they must not be read as equal full-image training budgets. This is not a controlled architecture ablation. Paper Table 2 accuracy 99.72% and Table 5 accuracy 99.82% are inconsistent and not reproduced.

Primary labels Angry/Sad. Secondary labels Angry/Sad/Bored/Stressed/Happy. StandardScaler fitted inside each training-subject fold; fixed logistic regression C=1 and balanced loss. Cardiac features use real ECG-derived RR intervals, often shorter than 60 seconds, so they are exploratory ultra-short statistics, not clinical HRV. No disgust, face, weather or raga response is present. Both offset-sign conventions are reported separately; no favorable sign is selected after testing. Negative deltas are regressions. Original source annotations are psychologist assessments, not universal emotion ground truth.

Screenshot shows the actual participant-held-out physiology report. The new FER experiment uses validation-only checkpoint selection; the historically inspected combined test folder is not fresh or identity-disjoint. All errors remain included. Deployment is gated on full-test accuracy and macro F1 increasing without lower disgust recall. If that gate fails, the app retains its old classifier and reports the new experiment separately. No sample/simulated physiological result is used for the real-data metrics.
Future work and publication possibilities
Publication depends on sound data, rights and evaluation.
Train equal-budget attention / pooling ablations with multiple seeds, stronger split controls and calibrated uncertainty.
Collect consented listening feedback and expert-reviewed raga annotations. Evaluate chronological ranking and IKS ablation.
Extend the real physiology baseline with independent signal-quality review, confirmed annotation alignment and external participant validation.
A reproducibility or systems paper is plausible after these experiments. Clinical and patent claims require separate substantiation.
No publication acceptance, novelty, clinical efficacy or patentability is promised. Resolve third-party permissions before releasing catalog or checkpoint assets.
